OneLineDescription: Creates crafting recipes for scrolls at a ScrollCrafting workbench.
LongDescription: Generates ConstructibleObject recipes for every scroll in the load order at a ScrollCrafting workbench, using an inkwell, paper rolls, and a soul gem scaled to the spell's level. Pass 1 creates recipes visible when the player owns the scroll, the matching spell tome, or knows the spell. Pass 2 covers remaining scrolls with a scroll-ownership condition only.
